_what: In-house vs CalculiX 2.23 modal cross-check on the SOLID design domain.
_why: The manuscript's Sec 2.8 verification claim was inherited from an earlier revision whose design domain was a different size (220x56x44). Re-derived 2026-08-15 on the production 216x42x54 domain so the number in the text is a measurement, not a memory.
note: In-house is the stiffer of the two. Both are fully-integrated trilinear hexes; the spread bounds the discretisation uncertainty at 2 mm. Scaling the sweep down by 5.1% gives 131-242 Hz, still entirely inside the 83-267 Hz band, so the paper's conclusion is robust and the correction moves designs further inside the band.
c3d8i_attempt: Re-running with TYPE=C3D8I segfaults in ccx 2.23 (exit 139) when MASS elements are present; not pursued.
